name: agent-roles
description: Route subagents to models and effort from one role map

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mod on for new sessions. /roles on|off overrides it for a session.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: The role map as JSON: {"version":1,"roles":{...},"agents":{...}}. Empty routes nothing. /roles set|bind|unbind edits it.

untypedPolicy.title: Untyped policy
untypedPolicy.description: What to do with Agent calls whose type is in untypedAgents: warn (run, and tell the model which typed agents exist), allow, or deny.

untypedAgents.title: Untyped agents
untypedAgents.description: Agent types untypedPolicy covers: catch-alls with no specialist definition. An Agent call with no subagent_type counts as general-purpose.

defaultRole.title: Default role
defaultRole.description: A role from routing for untyped spawns; empty leaves them native.
